name: Nene Amano
main_effect:
[On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Knightmon] or [DeadlyAxemon] in its name or [Twilight] trait among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Opponent's Turn] All of your Digimon with [DarkKnightmon] in their names or [Twilight] trait gain ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
[On Deletion] Gain 2 memory.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
